name: ground-forces
notes: Demon ground army, allied human ground units (never killed: totalled, limping, crew pods), ground effects and the ground-to-air missile. Every value is an input to tools/ground_forces_assets.py. Silhouettes, launchers and every animation frame are authored on the texel grid; each unit's selected ComfyUI keyframe (LayerDiffuse transparent sprite) contributes a -1/0/+1 shading texture on its hull ramp, so all frames stay aligned pixel for pixel. Demon hull ramps are picked from the sector palette plus the reserved demon_steel greys at the demon_ramp luminances (chroma <= demon_hull_chroma). v3: allies are authored seen from behind and above (driving up the plane with the convoy) by a deterministic solid rasteriser (hull layer + turret layer at five screen angles, or an infantry squad); the old ally keyframes contribute a sparse hull grit texture. Effects (10-frame explosion, shock ring, scorch decals, dust, smoke, flames, debris, muzzle flashes, impacts) are authored procedurally from seeded noise.
style_prompt: pixel art, 16-bit arcade shooter game sprite, single vehicle seen from a high 3/4 top-down front view, facing right, side and top visible, night lighting, crisp square pixels, original artwork, centered, isolated
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, horizon, clouds, ground, landscape, scenery, trees, grass, cute, cartoon, chibi, many objects, crowd
